answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farms. A willow survives the tundra winter; a fake does not. Each epoch a beacon picks five random auditors per agent, and every claim is signed with a quill-stamped bond of 40 credits locked 20 epochs. A fake failing audit loses bond and slot. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 credits at 120 per epoch each, so the farm needs 33 epochs to break even. An honest agent pays once and keeps its earnings whole.
